properties.description: If true the shader contains computation which produces the same value for every invocation in a draw call or compute dispatch.
properties.name: has_uniform_computation

properties.description: If true the shader has in-memory side-effects that are visible to the application. Shaders with side-effects cannot do early-zs testing or be occluded by hidden surface removal.
properties.name: has_side_effects

properties.description: If true the shader can modify fragment coverage mask. Shaders with modifiable coverage cannot do early-ZS update and cannot be hidden surface occluders.
properties.name: modifies_coverage

properties.description: If true the shader uses a late ZS test. Shaders using a late ZS test that are killed are a potential source of inefficiency.
properties.name: uses_late_zs_test

properties.description: If true the shader uses a late ZS update. Shaders using a late ZS update can cause later fragment at the same coordinate to stall due a depth dependency.
properties.name: uses_late_zs_update

properties.description: If true the shader programmatically reads from the color buffer. Shaders that read from the color buffer are treated as transparent, and cannot be hidden surface occluders.
properties.name: reads_color_buffer

properties.description: Number of read-write work registers used.
properties.name: work_registers_used

properties.description: Number of read-only uniform registers used.
properties.name: uniform_registers_used

properties.description: Number of bytes of stack memory allocated.
properties.name: stack_size

properties.description: True if one or more registers were spilled to the stack.
properties.name: has_stack_spilling

properties.description: Number of bytes allocated to stack spilling.
properties.name: stack_spill_bytes

properties.description: Number of bytes allocated to stack alloca.
properties.name: stack_alloca_bytes
